_README: Female right metacarpals I-V, individually split from the existing metacarpals_right plane-cut mask (vhf_arm_bones_ct.nii.gz label 4) by a marker-controlled watershed on her own torso CT's raw HU values (scripts/vhf_split_metacarpals.py). Derived data. Carpals and individual phalanges were investigated with the same technique and declined -- see the Q125 PROJECT_STATE entry.
source: U.S. National Library of Medicine, The Visible Human Project (public domain), female 'Normal' CT via the NCI Imaging Data Commons (series b9cf8e7a-2505-4137-9ae3-f8d0cf756c13).
